text:
Riley: Quick poll for tomorrow lunch: treadmill intervals in the office gym (30m) vs park fartlek (easy 5k with pickups). Treadmill is predictable, park has fresh air + some hills. Also optional donut stop after. Who's in? :running_shirt_with_sash:

Dana: Park for me. Hills > monotony. I can lead a tempo pickup plan. :sun_with_face:

Owen: Treadmill — need a stable pace for a workout I can time. Also towel + cold shower needed after. :sweat_drops:

Priya: Park! I promise not to make it a Strava segment challenge this time. :grimacing: Also happy to bring a banana run-boost.

Riley: React with :treadmill: for gym, :deciduous_tree: for park, :doughnut: if you'd like to join for donuts afterwards. I'll check gym availability and park permits.

Dana: :deciduous_tree: :doughnut: (only if chocolate)

Owen: :treadmill:

Priya: :deciduous_tree:

wellness-bot: Heads-up: Gym lane 1 reserved 12:00-12:40 tomorrow for group workouts if booked. Automated: reply "book" to reserve.

Riley: Park is winning 2-1. If gym reservation goes through we can pivot. Plan B: meet lobby 11:55, decide on the spot by headcount. If park, group will do 5k with 4x30s pickups; if treadmill, 3x8min threshold + 2min recovery. Donut optional after both. :sparkles:

Owen: If park, anyone with a small speaker? I can bring one.

Priya: I have a tiny speaker and a spare banana. DM me shoe size if you need to borrow trail shoes (I have one pair 8UK).

Dana: I'll scout a flatter loop near the fountain in case anyone wants low-impact. See you 11:55. :sunrise_over_mountains:
